question.prompt: \(AB\) is a diameter of \(\odot O\), and \(C\) lies on the circle. How many degrees is \(\angle ACB\)? (\(C\) does not coincide with \(A\) or \(B\); unit: degrees.)

solutions.explanation: An inscribed angle subtended by a diameter is a right angle, so \(\angle ACB=90^\circ\).
solutions.title: Angle subtended by a diameter
